text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm sorry about that! Um, would you grant us a little of your time?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: After our aquarium outing the other day, Meek and I got to talking about a lot of things, and she said something that hit me hard.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "I want to win it all with you. So I'll do everything I can to make that happen."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: So I think that's why she came up to you all fired up like that. Do I have that right, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: You guys are like role models to us.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: And you're rivals, too. Our rivalry pushes us to grow.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: If we challenge each other, we'll get stronger. Way stronger, I bet.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm making the first move. I'm here to challenge you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm on board with Meek and I'll also give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I think it'll be good for all of us to compare training results and stats and such…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: So if it's not too much trouble, will you consider accepting her challenge?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as she says, I do believe it would be beneficial for <chrname> too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Isn't that great, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll do my best.
